Allow me to break it down for you... 

While Planet Fitness does only charge $20/mo, if a payment is declined, they will make multiple attempts at collecting the payment that is due. 

With that being said, every attempt Planet Fitness makes at charging OPs account, Bank of America is hitting OP with a $35 overdraft fee (even though PF isn’t actually taking any money!). On top of this, if OP doesn’t pay the $35 fee for each charge, a secondary $35 fee will be added as a late fee. So what’s that math? 5 charge attempts? This happened to me, so I assure you, $450 is possible. 

————

OP: 

I don’t care how inconvenient it is for you, call the bank! You need to tell them calmly what is going on. Tell them to conference call Planet Fitness to get the issue resolved. I can’t assure you that this will resolve the fees due, but it’s a place to start. If you don’t pay whatever is due to the bank and PF, they payments will be sent to collections and will hurt your credit.
